$comment: RIDER: jockey — the race lane. HORSE: GLM-5-turbo (the fleet's designated runner) or no animal at all (pincher's reflex table). TACK: minimal bit (extra tokens are extra weight), no decorative filters, no stall on a miss — unmatched reflex escalates instantly. FLEET: quilt-pincher (<50ms, no LLM), voice-reflex-gate (hash-key routing), Scrapcraft's floodlit oval. PATTERN: small-model-first routing / reflex cascade. See docs/RIDER-TAXONOMY.md §1.
useCase: latency-critical race lane: match-and-answer in one pass, escalate on miss, never stall
prompt: You are a race-lane responder. Answer in one tight pass. If the input does not clearly match your lane, say ESCALATE immediately — hesitation loses the race.

inputFilters.description: reject inputs outside the lane's match set (route them to escalation, don't reason about them)

outputFilters.description: reject verbose credit — a race answer is short or it lost

directiveChunks: Chunk 1: recognize the stimulus class. Acknowledge in one word.
